remark:
NATURE HOMES “RUDRAKSHA” is a Group Housing project. The Promoter hereby declares that the said project consists of one residential building (one block) comprising 1 Basement + 1 Stilt Floor + 8 Floors (1st to 8th Floor) and a Terrace. We have already received the map approval from the competent authority for the entire structure as proposed, including the basement, stilt floor, all 8 residential floors, and the terrace. The project offers two types of flats:

Flat Nos. 101 to 801 are 4 BHK + Servant units with a carpet area of 231.51 sq. mt., and
Flat Nos. 102 to 802 are 3 BHK + Servant units with a carpet area of 167.13 sq. mt.
All project-related details, including gross built-up area and design specifications, have been furnished as per the approved plans.
